headline: The last two roads seat themselves
lede: WATCH batch 23 puts the arcade's final two proven routes behind the Y key: Rogue descends on the same BFS the harness clears every test seed with, and Metroid-LITE replays its zero-hit relic run — fresh roads only, honest no-guide the moment you steer.

notes.text: ROGUE: watchStep lifted out of roguecheck into sim.js — stair-seek, bump-attack, descend; seats anywhere, re-plans from the live dungeon every turn, and the pilot's untouched run dug to depth 3.
METROID-LITE: planRun's zero-hit win replayed tick-for-tick; seating re-anchors an unused road to the witness's tick 0, so a full Y-drive lands RELIC RECOVERED, 0 deaths, full energy.
The catch worth keeping: a tick-indexed script seat must start at the witness's tick 0 — mid-idle seating pose-desyncs the route. Re-anchor on fresh roads, decline on steered ones.
Both new seats died correctly under mutants; roguecheck 76/76, metroidcheck 49/49, watchphonecheck 443/443, prod verified by content in index-U22epagg.js.
